title: Governed restart for completed but inactive Hostinger Production build

phases.objective: Provide a one-time owner-authorized, exact-main-head and exact-Production-SHA Hostinger Node.js restart that verifies the completed build UUID, performs only the official server restart operation, and requires public runtime parity afterward.

e2e_journeys.actor: repository owner and trusted default-branch GitHub Actions runner
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Exact owner-authored Issue #4953 trigger bound to the current main head and completed Hostinger build 019fc51c-3947-7255-aa4d-f55cb8df7658
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The workflow fails closed if repository, Production, incident, build, secret, or duplicate-execution bindings differ; otherwise it restarts only the existing Hostinger Node.js server, uploads secret-free evidence, and passes only when auth.mad4b.com reports Production at f5c1ae8840b4d4452f2908bb0f23051880bb6896.
steps: Receive the exact owner trigger on open Issue #4953.
Verify current main equals the explicitly supplied full SHA and protected Production remains f5c1ae8840b4d4452f2908bb0f23051880bb6896.
Reject duplicate execution for the exact Production SHA and Hostinger build UUID binding.
Fetch Hostinger build history and require the latest build after the Production merge to be completed build 019fc51c-3947-7255-aa4d-f55cb8df7658 with Git source.
Read health, version, and deployment-info before mutation and skip restart if exact Production runtime parity already exists.
Poll bounded public runtime endpoints and require exact Production SHA and branch identity.
Upload structured secret-free evidence and publish a bounded issue marker while keeping the incident open.
assertions: The production workflow has only the issue_comment entrypoint and no pull_request_target trigger.
Only the authorized repository owner user ID and exact issue trigger can enter the restart job.
The workflow grants contents:read and issues:write only; it cannot mutate repository contents or protected refs.
The implementation rejects any newer or different Hostinger build and any non-completed authorized build before POST.
The only Hostinger provider mutation is the official Node.js server restart endpoint.
The operation never creates a build, uploads an archive, redeploys, changes branch binding, runs SQL, applies migrations, or mutates a database.
The Hostinger token is never returned and all artifacts declare secrets_included=false.
Success requires public runtime identity Production at exact SHA f5c1ae8840b4d4452f2908bb0f23051880bb6896.

phases.objective: Execute one authorized restart against the exact completed build and attach the run-bound evidence to Incident #4953.
Exercise stale head, changed Production, newer build, duplicate trigger, missing secret, provider failure, and post-restart stale runtime cases while remaining fail-closed.
The operation is a bounded restart of the existing production server process and does not create a separate canary deployment.
Record exact runtime parity after the one-time restart and retain rollback evidence if the process remains on the old release.
